input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-source, or "all requirements" obligation is imposed on Bluefly anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "exclusive"/"sole" return only unrelated uses: tax-exclusive charges (§ 4.3), the warranty disclaimer (§ 5.2), nonexclusive licenses (§§ 5.4, 12.1), and "sole discretion" references. Affirmatively, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) confirms each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others, so we retain full freedom to buy comparable hosting services from other suppliers. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer); no redline needed.
